Both proposals agree on binary, but labeler weak/forced versus blind supported; retain weakness and adjudicate applicability.

sources.excerpt: DX NetOps Performance Management monitors, stores, analyzes, and displays information for assuring service quality across large, complex, multi-technology, multi-vendor network infrastructure. ... DX NetOps Performance Management is the new name for CA Systems Performance for Infrastructure Managers (SPIM). Broadcom purchased this technology from CA Technologies.
sources.applicability: VA TRM entry links CA-origin SPIM to DX NetOps and describes conventional monitoring functions; relevant identity/function evidence but not a complete historical feature inventory.

sources.excerpt: DX NetOps Performance Management monitors, stores, analyzes, and displays information for assuring service quality across large, complex, multi-technology, multi-vendor network infrastructure. Key features include intelligent analytics, customizable dashboards, and predictive analytics; configurable and dynamic projections provide insight into capacity planning.
sources.applicability: Blind-retained 25.4 successor documentation. Predictive analytics/projections do not explicitly establish AI and do not prove historical scope.

sources.excerpt: CA Performance Management is a converged network operations monitoring solution that discovers traditional, physical inventories as well as modern, dynamic inventories in virtual and logical overlays. CA Performance Management is a comprehensive and highly scalable network performance monitoring and analytics platform.
sources.applicability: Exact assigned identity and description; analytics alone is not AI evidence.
